text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—They pass the 200-meter mark!
Here comes Symboli Kris S!
Symboli Kris S!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (Now is the time to show it: the certain victory forged together with my Trainer—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Haaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The pack is giving fierce chase!!
But Symboli Kris S!!
It's Symboli Kris S, across the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"No need for the title of Kikuka-sho Umamusume!! Symboli Kris S wants the Tenno Sho shield!
She has magnificently conquered the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!!"
(WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoaaa! So strongーー!!
She didn't show a hint of trouble that whole race...!
That was a complete blowout...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Man, I just saw something incredible...!
Symboli Kris S...
Her strength really is the real deal, huh—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A strength that shakes the earth and pierces the heavens...
A sharpness akin to an unwavering blade flashing forth...!
Clad in radiant brilliance, standing atop the vanguard of battle...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Gaze upon them—thus stands a Hero"—
...Next year, I swear I'll follow in Kris S-san's footsteps...!

—Haha!
Like a tempest... no, more like a blizzard, maybe?
Seems like it's about time I went and said hello—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (—Don't rush.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(This victory is only just the beginning.
——I'll use it as a breakthrough and change things from here.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Onto the next.
Symboli Kris S conquered the grueling race, showcasing her true strength. I wanted to congratulate her on the victory with genuine emotion, but――

From the expression on her face when she returned,
I sensed it was still too early for that,
and braced myself once more...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. —We have... only just begun.
—This is not enough.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I have a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
My next race... I want to aim for...
the grand prix—the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"With that 'result'—
I will make the strength I showed today even more undeniable."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Are there—any objections, I wonder?
choice_data_list: No, actually, I'm all for it!
No, actually, I'm all for it!

text_block_list.text:
Throughout the journey leading to the Autumn Tenno Sho,
Symboli Kris S's abilities grew leaps and bounds...!

"With how she is now, even at 2,500 meters,
she should be capable of running just as strongly as she did today."
choice_data_list: Let's get "results" and make this year yours.
Let's get "results" and make this year yours.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. ...Memory.
I will demonstrate strength—enough to overwrite their memories.

And so, without lingering on the euphoria of victory,
we set our sights firmly on the Arima Kinen—
—A few days later.
When I arrived at the track with Symboli Kris S for training—

Suddenly, upbeat dance music starts blasting
at full volume. Wondering what's going on, I look around—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ――Look at me!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we settle this with a dance battle?!
Symboli Kris S!!
The one who appeared was Tap Dance City. An Umamusume competing in the Senior Class with a free-spirited, daring running style, and—

Coincidentally, like Symboli Kris S,
she is an Umamusume hailing from abroad. The chances
of them racing together in the future are very high...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —For what purpose?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Consider it my greeting. As fellow pursuers of 'romance,'
let's have some fun together!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —The same... "romance"...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Curious, are ya? Then just surrender yourself to the flow!
—To the rough waves known as me!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Why do they overlap—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
......
...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...She doesn't seem to have any intention of moving aside.
For the sake of our training—
please allow me to compete with her.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! Now that's a Trainer who gets it!
Well then, let's get started!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...The rules are...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Something like that—we'll figure it out while we're making noise!

text_block_list.name: Spectator Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—H-Hey, listen up!
They say Kris S-senpai and Tap-senpai are having
a dance battle over there right now!

text_block_list.name: Spectator Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-san, your race line is insane...!
Your sharpness is unbelievable...!

The dance battle that Symboli Kris S and the others spontaneously started
had drawn in a massive crowd before anyone realized it...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heh, precise and calm as a machine.
Just like your running, that's your strength!
However—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: The fiery passion driving my "Romance"... isn't something that can be snuffed out by a little coldness like that!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Energy—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Look at this! This is my true 'passion'!!"
Suddenly picking up the tempo, Tap Dance City burst into an all-out dance, weaving in breathtakingly fast tap steps!

It was as if—she were dancing
as she ran along the track...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, a-amazing!
I've never seen anything like that before!

text_block_list.name: Spectator Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It's so wild you can't even tell what she's dancing—
but it's super cool...!

An overwhelming volume of motion compressed into a single fraction of a second.
Within it shone unmistakable finesse, technical precision, and expressive power.
Above all—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hahahahaha!!!

"Seeing Tap Dance City look so joyful,
there was a 'passion' that set my heart ablaze...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: This is... frenzy—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like this round is my loss.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah! Oh yeah, this was a contest!
Got so carried away making noise that I forgot!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Still, you really are something.
To touch my heat and yet remain so cool—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, now I'm even more intrigued.
Just how are you going to make this "romance"—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Just how she intends to bring about this "revolution," you know?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............
――"Romance." Is that... a goal?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Don't go raining on my parade.
"Romance" is "romance"!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Your "revolution" isn't something that can be summed up with such petty words, is it?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Shatter the world, smash common sense, destroy it all!!
That's what it takes to achieve a ridiculously massive 'dream' like this!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
“—We're both from overseas. On top of that, since you were specially invited to this academy,
I've been secretly keeping an eye on you to see what kind of person you are.”

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Watching the race, I knew immediately.
A ruthless strength that crushes everything in its path. That thing is—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It belongs to the one who keeps their eyes fixed forward,
to fulfill one hell of a grand "dream"...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Are you the type who'd rather hash things out in a run
than mess around partying?
If so, then—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—The Arima Kinen! There, I'll feel your strength,
your coldness, your "romance"—
every single bit of it, firsthand!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...So that's the real point.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heh—
Shall I throw you a handkerchief?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—There's... no need.
No matter who my opponent is... I will win.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Cool!
That's what I'm talking about—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
And... they somehow felt similar.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Gimlet, and the heat...—

Tap Dance City might just become a formidable rival
standing in Symboli Kris S's way down the road—

It was a sudden event in broad daylight
that made one think just that.

The next objective: the Arima Kinen.
The grand finale of the Classic class
was drawing near—
